# Claude Code fixtures

Synthetic sessions for `test/adapter-claude.test.mjs`, generated by
`make-fixtures.mjs` (deterministic lorem text, seeded PRNG). Regenerate with:

```
node packages/cli/test/fixtures/claude/make-fixtures.mjs
```

This directory plays the role of one `~/.claude/projects/<project-dir>/`
folder, so the layout matches the real one (`docs/format-claude-code.md` §0):

| File | Session |
|---|---|
| `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.jsonl` | plain: state records first, streamed assistant chunks sharing one `message.id`, Read with numbered lines, parallel tool results in one user record, Skill flow (tool_use → tool_result → `isMeta` body → `command_permissions`), MCP tool, `<synthetic>` error record, a prompt containing a raw U+2028, an `isVisibleInTranscriptOnly` record, `queue-operation` and `cost-state` state records |
| `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002.jsonl` | one auto `compact_boundary` with `compactMetadata` (`preservedMessages.uuids` names the last two records, so the in-flight Bash `tool_use` is dropped by the boundary while its `tool_result` and the reminder stay), the `isCompactSummary` record, and the post-compaction attachment re-injection |
| `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004.jsonl` | harness run (ADR-005 §2): `entrypoint: sdk-cli`, temp cwd `/private/var/folders/…/cez-root-isolation-4`, a Haiku model, one prompt with re-injected listings, one request (thinking + text), no tool call — classified `kind: "harness"` by the index |
| `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005.jsonl` | temp copy of a repo (ADR-005 §2): temp cwd `…/cez-root-lease-5`, a `nested_memory` attachment carrying `NESTED_MEMORY_TEXT` as `packages/api/CLAUDE.md`, five whole-file Reads of `TEMP_TARGETS` and a Bash `cat` of the sixth (kind `file`, target set by the command parser); `test/attribution.test.mjs` matches it against a temporary repo by nested-file hash and by file-path overlap |
| `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003.jsonl` + `…0003/subagents/` | five subagents: one async (`async_launched` placeholder, then a standalone `<task-notification>` user record), one sync (the Agent `tool_result` is the handoff), one nested at depth 2 launched from inside the async agent, one whose notification is absorbed mid-turn as a `queued_command` attachment (`commandMode: "task-notification"`, the delivery seen on 106 real agents), one whose notification arrives inside the `tool_result` of a blocking Bash call next to a Monitor notification (synthetic only); plus a standalone Monitor task notification that is not an agent, a ranged `Read` (`offset`/`limit`) and a `sed -n` Bash read for `tool.partial` |
| `expected.json` | numbers the adapter must reproduce (distinct message ids, totals, compaction fields, scope links, handoff byte sizes) |

Never copy real transcripts here: the privacy test asserts that no content or
absolute path outside `~` survives into the Run, and the fixtures exist so the
adapter can be tested without any real session on disk.
